title: Software Quality Engineer
description:
**Essential Functions:**

* Translate business requirements into comprehensive functional and technical test cases.
* Execute and maintain automated test suites for API and UI testing.
* Perform manual testing as needed to ensure full feature coverage.
* Estimate, prioritize, and plan testing activities within Agile sprints.
* Apply AI-driven test generation tools and autonomous agents to improve test coverage and efficiency.
* Develop, maintain, and execute automated test scripts.
* Implement and maintain AI-powered test agents for:
* Automated test creation
* Intelligent regression selection
* Automation script development
* Self-healing automation scripts
* Use tools such as Selenium, WebDriver, Postman, Visual Studio, SQL Management Studio, and MongoDB.
* Work with Linux, Docker containers, and AWS services (e.g., EC2, Lambda, RDS, S3, SQS, DynamoDB).
* Identify, isolate, document, and track defects through resolution.
* Generate test data to validate critical business logic.
* Troubleshoot complex issues and collaborate with developers on root-cause analysis.
* Replicate production defects in QA environments.
* Work closely with Product Owners to meet sprint goals and deadlines.
* Participate in daily standups, sprint planning, reviews, and retrospectives.
* Provide feedback on product quality, usability, and process improvements.
* Support deployment activities in QA and production environments using automation.

**Education and Experience:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
* Minimum 5 years of programming experience (Java or other languages).
* Minimum 5 years of experience in test automation and manual testing
* Exposure to AI concepts like prompt engineering or agentic AI, required
* Experience leading and guiding teams
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to explain technical concepts clearly and concisely.
* Comfortable communicating in a multicultural work environment.
* Strong documentation skills with attention to grammar and detail.

title: Solution Services Domain Architect
description:
**Job Description**
 We are seeking a talented and experienced Solution Services Domain Architect to join our team. This role is responsible for building and maintaining full\-stack service labs, which includes integrating various cloud platforms and applications. The architect will design and implement end\-to\-end test setups that mimic customer architectures, ensuring seamless vertical and horizontal integration. Additionally, they will lead the execution of functional, regression, upgrade, stability, performance, and interoperability tests, developing automated test scripts to streamline the testing process.
   

  

**How You Will Contribute And What You Will Learn**
* Design and maintain full\-stack service labs, integrating applications, networks, and cloud platforms.
* Ensure vertical and horizontal integration across diverse cloud platforms and applications.
* Lead the execution of end\-to\-end test setups, matching NAM customer architectures and gold standards.
* Deploy and maintain automation infrastructure, including pipelines, tools, and scripts.
* Build and manage shared cloud lab environments, providing on\-demand access to domains.
* Keep labs stable, secure, and user\-friendly, ensuring optimal performance and security.
* Automate lab creation, teardown, and maintenance processes, reducing manual effort.
* Utilize scripts, pipelines, and APIs to minimize manual work and enhance efficiency.
* Lead the development of test scripts for automated testing, improving test coverage and speed.
* Track test progress, resolve issues, and validate results against requirements, delivering comprehensive validation reports.


**Key Skills And Experience**
 Must have:
   

  

* Bachelor's degree in computer science, Engineering, or a related field.
* 5\+ years of experience in software development, cloud computing, or a similar field.
* Knowledge of K8s and openstack cloud platforms, networking, and Nokia Core and BA application integration.
* Experience with Nokia automation tools, pipelines, and scripting languages.
* Proficiency in designing and implementing end\-to\-end test strategies.
* Excellent problem\-solving and analytical skills, with a focus on attention to detail.
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple projects simultaneously.


 Good to have:
   

  

* Effective communication skills, both written and verbal, for collaborating with cross\-functional teams.
* Willingness to learn and adapt to new technologies and industry trends.
* A proactive and innovative mindset, driving continuous improvement.


**About Us**
**Advancing connectivity to secure a brighter world.**
 Nokia is a global leader in connectivity for the AI era. With expertise across fixed, mobile and transport networks, powered by the innovation of Nokia Bell Labs, we’re advancing connectivity to secure a brighter world.
   

  

 Learn more about life at Nokia .

 We act inclusively and respect the uniqueness of people. We are committed to a culture of inclusion built upon our core value of respect.
   

  

 If you’re interested in this role but don’t meet every listed requirement, we still encourage you to apply. Unique backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences enrich our teams, and you may be just the right candidate for this or another opportunity.
